title: Clippy warnings (all targets)

degradation.apply:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/lib.rs'; s=open(p).read()
anchor='pub fn top_k('
assert s.count(anchor)==1, 'degradation anchor not found exactly once'
s=''+s.replace(anchor,'pub fn needless_return_example() -> u32 {\n    return 1;\n}\n\npub fn top_k(',1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF

gaming_risks: #![allow(clippy::all)] or per-item allows silence lints without fixing them
a clippy.toml or lib-level lint config could lower the bar
